summary: Iteration 11 fixes verified. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass — new Unsplash URL returns 200, all 9 seeded providers each expose 4 valid gallery URLs (HEAD 200), fresh empty provider signup is correctly gated out (count stays at 9), provider detail includes gallery+reviews+rate_bucket. Frontend: /find-providers renders 9 cards, no broken images on grid or profile pages, clearChip refactor works cleanly (chip removed, no page errors, sort/rating/service picker/nav all functional).
critical_code_review_comments: Empty-provider gate at server.py:1136 uses `bio AND rating>0` — but a freshly registered provider is seeded with rating=4.7 (server.py:428). Gate works only because bio starts as ''. If future code defaults bio to any non-empty string, empty providers will re-appear. Consider using an explicit `profile_completed` flag instead of relying on bio truthiness.
/api/providers/search response shape changed to {count, results} — ensure all frontend consumers are updated; existing test suite expectations from prior iterations may break.
seed_data_creation: Created a couple of TEST_ prefixed customer+provider users via /api/auth/register to validate the gate; harmless.
